segmentName: Hybrid Crop Seeds (vegetable/field crop hybrids, India)

market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates diverge sharply by methodology: $25.6-30.9B (2025/26, Mordor Intelligence / Market Data Forecast / Coherent Market Insights) to $59.7-65.1B (2025, Expert Market Research / Future Market Insights) — nearly a 2x spread depending on scope/definition. CAGR clusters ~6.4-8.2%/yr across sources.
exportGeographies: Bangladesh (~59% of India's hybrid seed export shipments)
other Africa (~8% of vegetable seed exports)
globalCompetitors: Nuziveedu Seeds (largest Bt cotton seed company in India)
market.domesticSlice: India domestic seed market: $8.6B (2025) to $20.2B by 2034

structureFacts: Seed Replacement Rate (SRR) structure: hybrids require ~100% annual repurchase since they lose yield potential (heterosis) if farm-saved and replanted, versus 25-33% SRR targets for self/cross-pollinated crops — this is the core recurring-demand driver for a hybrid-seed business specifically
Hybrid seed delivers a 25-40% yield increase over traditional/open-pollinated varieties
Draft Seeds Bill 2025 and the National Food Security & Nutrition Mission (2025-26) are cited policy tailwinds; states are increasingly mandating QR-based seed authentication/traceability

adoptionStructure.note: Near-100% annual repurchase for true F1 hybrids specifically (distinct from the ~15% national fresh-seed SRR figure used in the crop-seeds/Eldorado segment file, which blends hybrids with self-pollinated crops) — hybrid-specific demand is structurally the most recurring tier within the broader seed category

peers.name: Kaveri Seed Company
peers.note: ~17x Unisem's revenue scale — a structural 'at scale' benchmark, not a size peer

peers.name: Nuziveedu Seeds
peers.note: largest Bt cotton seed company in India; data across sources inconsistent (EBITDA both +38% CAGR and -9.92% YoY cited) — treat cautiously, may reflect a loss-affected or restated year

drivers: brand loyalty and prior experience — the strongest predictor of repeat choice, especially when a preferred variety is unavailable
price acts as a quality-signaling cue rather than the primary driver

steps: breed proprietary germplasm / hybrid traits (disease tolerance, yield)
select via genetic markers, QTL mapping, marker-assisted selection
field-trial and validate hybrids across agro-climatic zones
farmer purchases seed each season (near-100% SRR for true hybrids)
repeat next season — structurally forced, not optional, for true hybrids
